cases.name: process_argument_errors
cases.source:
for _,f in ipairs({os.execute,os.exit}) do
          for _,v in ipairs({false,{},function()end}) do
            local ok,e=pcall(f,v);print(ok,e)
          end
        end
        local t={execute=os.execute,exit=os.exit}
        local ok,e=pcall(function()return t:execute()end);print(ok,e)
        local ok,e=pcall(function()return t:exit()end);print(ok,e)

extra.not_run: The historical std launcher would parse a PE executable as batch-file commands. Native/reference/CLI checks still run.

limitations: Fixed isolated process probes; ASCII Windows environment/path contract. Not a full OS-library or host-process resource audit.
